build_pt_transform: build a torchvision transform pipeline that resizes, converts to tensor, and normalizes images with ImageNet stats
load_pretrained_mae_weights: load pretrained MAE encoder weights from a local PyTorch checkpoint file into a model
forward_mae: run inference with MAE models to extract patch-wise features from both HuggingFace and PyTorch implementations
create_webssl_mae_model: create a WebSSL MAE model instance such as webssl_mae1b_full2b_224 or webssl_mae3b_full2b_224
compare_hf_pt_features: compare patch-wise feature outputs between HuggingFace ViTModel and PyTorch MAE model implementations
